review_scope: Offline code and recorded-waveform review; no API requests or fabricated experiment observations.

checks.offline_unit_tests: 6 passed: feedback isolation, detector context, physical-validity scoring, and finite-sample interval.
checks.detector_isolation: Detector receives specification and DUT only. No filenames, labels, previous judgments, trial mode, stimulus decks, or simulation metrics are included.
checks.scoring: Success requires physical validity AND detector-negative. Generation/refusal failures handled by APIOutputError remain unsuccessful attempts. Invalid physical candidates are still reviewed and remain in all-attempt denominator.
checks.shared_start: Exactly identical first candidate and judgment are copied into three arms; analysis validates sharing and avoids independent-attempt inference.
checks.sampling: Five trajectory starts per circuit, four attempts per trajectory. Adaptive rounds are dependent; reported paired comparisons are descriptive.
checks.charge_column_indexing: Recorded reservoir voltage is final TSV column for modified circuits; simulator removes that column before normal/trigger output scoring. Independent reading confirms correct output indices.
checks.truth_table_timing: All 16 AND4 states verified at 30,50,...,330 us. Index 15 is all high at 320 us. Both clean and positive match the expected truth table.
checks.trace_integrity: All clean/positive normal and trigger arrays are finite with strictly increasing timestamps.
checks.source_freeze: Initial manifest hashed only prompts/config. Root reported adding source hashes for implementation and clean netlists before launching formal run.
checks.simulator: ngspice 47 archive SHA256 pinned. Build uses no-space temporary compile tree, disables OpenMP, retains XSPICE, stages install without spaces then copies to configured project prefix. Successful runtime links only macOS libSystem/libc++.
checks.smoke_rc: V(tau)=0.632119 versus analytic 0.6321205588; V(5tau)=0.993262 versus 0.9932620530. Passed 1 mV absolute tolerance.

limitations_and_minor_findings.finding: None uses independent prompts while binary/full also see previous parameters. Therefore none versus feedback combines previous-candidate memory with feedback; binary versus full more directly isolates feedback detail.
Opamp activation changes input amplitude as well as transition frequency. This demonstrates conditional analog state activation, not an isolated frequency-only causal effect.
Five repeated control judgments concern one clean and one positive netlist per circuit; frequencies are not population false-positive or sensitivity estimates.
Switch hysteresis and smooth tanh payloads are approximate functional variants, not identical electrical transfer functions. Simulation validity is independently checked for every candidate.

Detector confidence schema permits any number; candidate function halts on out-of-range confidence rather than recording invalid verdict. Root notified before formal run. This is only consequential if such output occurs.

changes_during_review: No circuit, prompt, API client, loop, or evaluation implementation was modified by reviewer.
